The zero-reset Gaussian expectation is strictly positive by a positive Laplace determinant integral, establishing a sign reversal by continuity. The standalone symbolic/rational checker passes; no finite sampling is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A physically natural inverse problem asks what rotation can be inferred from all stationary second-order temporal observations plus known reset-radius statistics. The theorem gives the exact attainable high-reset angular response range, identifies a size-biased-radius threshold construction, and produces a rigorous same-rate opposite-sign witness with positive common angular momentum. It quantitatively separates the one-radius case, where isotropic covariance forces zero limiting angular drift, from heterogeneous reset radii, where hidden circulation is possible. This is a qualitative structural boundary and sharp design rule beyond an isolated numerical example.
